title: Document bounded debug control options in the operation inventory
changes: Add reference descriptors for shared break/watch windows and guards, bounded local-control replay and typed-recipe reopening, preserving all historical Atlas operation contracts and existing response identities.
validation: The Python operation-inventory suite passed all three tests after previously reporting missing parser flags in three source files. Focused Linux tests passed four operation-registry and eleven command tests. Atlas regeneration preserved all 97 historical contracts.
limitations: These changes describe existing behavior and do not add runtime capabilities. Windows execution and the separate DBG2-20 parameter end-to-end proof remain outstanding.
